verdict.rationale: Undermind is a SaaS research service with an enterprise API, so an interactive API reference is a fair question for it. However, the evidence only mentions "Programmatic queries via API" and a "custom API" for GSK, plus MCP setup instructions. There is no documented interactive API explorer or runnable examples, and the OpenAPI/Swagger probes all returned 404.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples
